name: bitget_cashcarry_public_v1_20260716
purpose: Normalize a complete public Bitget V2 spot plus USDT perpetual instruments/orderbooks/current-and-historical-funding snapshot without keys, account state, orders, or Bybit source relabelling.

market_contract.spot: online spot symbol quoted in USDT
market_contract.perpetual: normal perpetual with productType=USDT-FUTURES and USDT margin support
market_contract.book: unmerged step0/scale0 with exact tick alignment and unique sorted sides
market_contract.time: server time fetched last; all response and book timestamps must be causal
market_contract.funding: contract fundInterval must equal current fundingRateInterval; history is deduplicated and sorted ascending
market_contract.funding_proxy: current public perp midpoint only when settlement is at most 120 seconds old

precision_contract.spot_min_qty: lowest positive qty step; official minTradeAmount is obsolete and minTradeUSDT is authoritative for notional
precision_contract.perp_tick: priceEndStep * 10^-pricePlace, checked against scale0 response scale

fee_contract.captured: public default takerFeeRate from both spot symbols and mix contracts responses
fee_contract.promotion_block: Public defaults cannot replace an account-specific fee-tier receipt.

source_separation.reason: Frozen Bybit v2 validates source=bybit_public_v5 and has Bybit-specific deterministic replay/economics receipts.

blockers_before_station: separate Bitget durable hash-chain journal and deterministic restart replay
Bitget-native common-quantity multi-level execution and economics engine
balance, margin, liquidation, transfer, outage, reconciliation, and two-leg recovery model
at least 10 completed public paper cycles for mechanics and 30 cycles across 3 liquid symbols for manual edge review
